stem: Redwood Bio runs two workloads: short event handlers and long-running container jobs that exceed 15 minutes, and the team wants to avoid managing servers. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: AWS Lambda for the short event handlers
AWS Lambda for the long-running container jobs
AWS Outposts for the short event handlers
AWS Fargate tasks for the long-running container jobs
Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group for the long-running container jobs

rationale: Lambda matches short event-handler execution patterns, and Fargate supports long-running containers without server patch management. Lambda is not the right fit for long-running container jobs that exceed standard function duration limits. Outposts solves hybrid placement constraints rather than this serverless compute split. EC2 Auto Scaling can run the jobs but reintroduces host management that the scenario explicitly wants to avoid.
